assumptions.statement: The organization operates within the AWS ecosystem and is willing to accept vendor lock-in to utilize native services like ACM and ELB.
assumptions.quote: Technically this may be considered vendor lock-in, but the advantages significantly outweigh the cost.

assumptions.statement: The deployment infrastructure is managed using Terraform, allowing SSL termination on ELBs to be codified and managed through infrastructure-as-code.
assumptions.quote: Terminate SSL on ELBs means the deployment is managed through Terraform

assumptions.statement: The team is willing to accept the manual effort of creating certificates in ACM, as automation for this specific step is not available.
assumptions.quote: We can only manually create certificates in ACM so are unable to automate this process, but we accept the time cost of doing this step.
